tasks.label: set-live-github-token
args:
set -e
TOKEN=$(printf 'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n' | git credential fill 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^password=//p' | head -n1)
if [[ -z "$TOKEN" ]]; then
  echo LOCAL_GITHUB_TOKEN_MISSING
  exit 0
fi
echo LOCAL_GITHUB_TOKEN_FOUND len=${#TOKEN}
printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | base64 > /tmp/gh_token.b64
scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /tmp/gh_token.b64 root@204.168.230.142:/tmp/gh_token.b64 >/dev/null
rm -f /tmp/gh_token.b64
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@204.168.230.142 "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64
env_path = Path('/var/www/unicorn/UNICORN_FINAL/.env')
b64_path = Path('/tmp/gh_token.b64')
if not b64_path.exists():
    print('REMOTE_B64_MISSING')
    raise SystemExit(1)
token = base64.b64decode(b64_path.read_text().strip()).decode('utf-8','ignore').strip()
if not token:
    print('REMOTE_TOKEN_EMPTY')
    raise SystemExit(1)
text = env_path.read_text() if env_path.exists() else ''
lines = [ln for ln in text.splitlines() if not ln.startswith('GITHUB_TOKEN=')]
lines.append('GITHUB_TOKEN=' + token)
env_path.write_text('\\n'.join(lines) + '\\n')
b64_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
print('GITHUB_TOKEN_SET len=' + str(len(token)))
PY"
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@204.168.230.142 'systemctl restart unicorn-rescue-backend && systemctl restart deepseek-loop && sleep 2 && echo backend=$(systemctl is-active unicorn-rescue-backend) loop=$(systemctl is-active deepseek-loop)'
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@204.168.230.142 "grep -E '^GITHUB_TOKEN=' /var/www/unicorn/UNICORN_FINAL/.env | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'"
